addresses.entity: Alliance Medical Products, Inc. (dba Siegfried Irvine)

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
Aseptic processing areas are deficient regarding the system for monitoring environmental conditions.

citations.short: Written calibration / inspection records not  kept
citations.long: Records of the calibration checks and inspections of automatic, mechanical or electronic equipment, including computers or related systems are not maintained.
There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
Aseptic processing areas are deficient regarding air supply that is filtered through high-efficiency particulate air filters under positive pressure.
Routine calibration of mechanical equipment is not performed according to a written program designed to assure proper performance.
Written production and process control procedures are not followed in the execution of production and process control functions.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.

citations.short: Validation lacking for sterile drug products
citations.long: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile do not include validation of the sterilization process.

citations.short: Items to cover on annual reviews
citations.long: Written procedures are not established for evaluations done at least annually and including provisions for a review of complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations conducted for each drug product.
